facts.text: Composite character reference sheet: a large hero image of a dragon occupies the top half, with six labeled detail/orthographic panels arranged in two rows below.

In the hero image, a large dark-scaled dragon stands in side profile facing left, head lowered toward shallow reflective water, with a long spiked tail extending right and a membranous wing raised behind it.
The dragon has charcoal-black scales with muted blue-gray highlights, long backward-swept pale horns, a crest and row of dorsal spikes, large bat-like wings, and clawed feet.
The hero environment is a dark volcanic rocky landscape with glowing orange lava fissures in the background, haze, and shallow water reflecting the dragon’s feet.
A panel labeled “FRONT” shows the dragon facing forward with both wings spread to either side and the tail visible behind.
A panel labeled “SIDE PROFILE” shows the full dragon from the side with its wings partly raised and its long tail extended behind.
A panel labeled “REAR” shows the dragon from behind with its wings spread wide and dorsal spikes running down the back.
A panel labeled “HEAD CLOSE” shows a close view of the dragon’s horned head, scaled face, and visible amber-colored eye.
A panel labeled “WING MEMBRANE” isolates the textured, veined wing membrane stretched between dark skeletal supports.
A panel labeled “CLAW AND FOOT” shows a close view of a scaly foot with prominent curved claws resting on dark rock.
A panel labeled “SCALE DETAIL” shows tightly overlapping dark scales with blue-gray iridescent highlights.

card.summary: A dark fantasy dragon character reference sheet featuring a large cinematic hero image above six labeled panels showing front, side, rear, head, wing, claw, and scale details.
